Static Architecture Analysis
|-- Entry contract: StaticAnalyzer.analyze(request)                         [ports.ts]
|   |-- Inputs: repository root/ID, tsconfig, selected paths, views, frameworks, metrics
|   |-- Selection limits fact emission; imports may be read for symbol resolution
|   `-- Result: AnalysisArtifact + separate elapsed/RSS/phase measurements
|       `-- Execution metadata records whether semantic resolution was used
|-- Direct CLI path                                                        [scripts/analysis/analyze.ts]
|   |-- Read tsconfig -> select .ts/.tsx files, excluding .d.ts
|   |   `-- Optional path prefixes narrow the selection
|   |-- Call staticAnalyzer directly, independently of the interactive backend
|   |   |-- Views: containment, lexical, calls, ownership, dependencies
|   |   |-- Frameworks: react, zustand, tldraw, controller
|   |   `-- Partitions: directory, layer, single-group; shuffle seed 1729, samples 32
|   `-- Persist selected-scope or whole-repository output
|       |-- Canonical artifact chunks -> gzip -> temporary file -> rename
|       |   `-- docs/analysis/artifacts/<scope>.json.gz
|       |-- architectureReport -> docs/analysis/architecture-<scope>.md
|       `-- <scope>.run.json: timings, timestamp, hashes, sizes, counts, coverage
|           `-- Run measurements remain outside deterministic artifact facts
|-- Extraction pipeline                                                    [analyzer.ts]
|   |-- 1. AnalysisContext: selected sources + lazy TypeScript compiler       [context.ts]
|   |   |-- Validate config and repository-relative selection; reject empty selection
|   |   |-- Start with syntax program: noLib, noResolve, no implicit types
|   |   `-- First symbol/type query -> full program + TypeChecker
|   |       `-- Reuse unchanged source ASTs; clear prior program for selections >100 files
|   |-- 2. Declarations.index -> imports -> composition                     [declarations.ts]
|   |   |-- Repository -> directories/packages -> modules -> declarations/scopes
|   |   |-- Record bindings, parameters, fields, functions, classes and type namespaces
|   |   |-- Resolve local names through scope bindings; use checker for imports/members
|   |   `-- Add import/reexport and JSX-child relations; summarize external declarations
|   |-- 3. Any requested view beyond containment -> extractLexical
|   |-- 4. Any calls/ownership/dependencies view requested
|   |   `-- Initialize Resources -> extractCalls -> extractFrameworks
|   |       `-- Ownership or dependencies requested
|   |           `-- Prepare dataflow symbol IDs -> release compiler
|   |               `-- extractDataflow -> connectCallbackCandidates
|   `-- 5. finish snapshot -> release context/caches -> deriveAnalysis -> return
|       `-- Compiler inputs are pinned before compiler state is released
|-- Evidence-bearing artifact                                              [schema.ts, context.ts]
|   |-- Snapshot pins the analyzed environment
|   |   |-- Source/configuration hashes, UTF-16 lengths, line counts, effective options
|   |   |-- File roles: analyzed, resolution-only, configuration
|   |   |-- Analyzer/compiler versions, scope, commit and dirty pinned inputs
|   |   `-- Snapshot ID hashes metadata; every fact range receives that snapshot ID
|   |-- Entities + relations + uncertainties carry explicit provenance
|   |   |-- Status, method, rule, source locations, supporting relation IDs, explanation
|   |   |-- Ranges: snapshot + path + file hash; UTF-16 offsets; exclusive end
|   |   `-- Entity identity uses owner/path/kind/name or structural fingerprint
|   |       `-- Collisions -> ambiguous identity + occurrence ordinal + uncertainty
|   |-- Five relation contracts
|   |   |-- containment: contains, imports, reexports, jsx-child
|   |   |-- lexical: scopes, declarations, references, captures, captures-this
|   |   |-- calls: calls, constructs, registers, schedules, resumes, returns-to
|   |   |-- ownership: creates, retains, aliases, mutation capabilities, disposal, escapes
|   |   `-- dependencies: value/argument/return flow, reads/writes, control, reactive flow
|   |-- Emission gate: containment edges always allowed; other edges require active view
|   `-- Coverage is reconstructed from persisted relations and uncertainties
|       `-- Per-view candidate/resolved/unresolved sites -> complete, partial or not-run
|-- Derived architecture                                                   [derive.ts]
|   |-- Universe: source entities with evidence in analyzed files
|   |   `-- Exclude structural containers, scopes, interfaces/types and external/unknown nodes
|   |-- Requested partitions -> group membership for each universe entity
|   |   `-- Directory | metadata layer | one group containing all source entities
|   |-- Active views select dependency layers
|   |   |-- calls: calls + constructs
|   |   |-- data: value-flow + argument + return + reads + writes
|   |   |-- state: reads + writes
|   |   `-- reactive: reactive + selects + prop-flow + context-read + effect-dependency
|   |       `-- Layer policies use resolved/inferred evidence and unit-per-relation weights
|   |-- evaluateAllPartitions -> metrics; directory is comparison partition when present
|   |   |-- Line coverage/overlap, edge mass, internal fraction, cohesion, variation of information
|   |   `-- Seeded shuffle baseline preserves primary group sizes and covered set
|   |-- Per-layer graph -> iterative Kosaraju -> strongly connected components
|   |   `-- Condensed component edges retain supporting relation IDs
|   |-- deriveFindings -> findings assessed as 'investigate'
|   `-- contains relations -> containment tree occurrences
|-- Optional incremental entry: IncrementalAnalyzer                         [incremental.ts]
|   |-- Session owns checkpoint fragments; concurrent updates are rejected
|   |-- Inventory current files, hashes, import resolutions and environment
|   |   `-- Current imports + still-valid prior dependency edges -> dependency components
|   |-- Conservative fallback -> one component spanning local files
|   |   `-- Global scripts/augmentations, dynamic resolution, declaration dependencies,
|   |       selected declaration files or mode-sensitive module resolution
|   |-- For each component with selected files
|   |   |-- Key: environment + selected paths + member hashes + resolution observations
|   |   |-- Cached key -> reuse fragment
|   |   `-- Missing key -> invoke extractor for that component's selected files
|   `-- Merge fragments -> fresh snapshot -> recompute all derived results
|       |-- Re-pin current commit/config/input set even when every fragment is reused
|       |-- Publish checkpoint only after successful assembly
|       `-- Report changed, analyzed, reused and removed files plus fallback reasons
`-- Diagram boundary: pinned leaf ranges -> source entities                 [sourceJoins.ts]
    |-- joinSourceRange(artifact, request): separate from the direct CLI extraction path
    |   |-- Snapshot mismatch, missing file or file-hash mismatch -> stale; no entity IDs
    |   |-- Range outside pinned file bounds -> throw
    |   `-- Valid pin -> select eligible source entities by range policy
    |       |-- fully-contained: entity range lies inside leaf range
    |       |-- intersects: entity and leaf ranges overlap
    |       `-- Sorted entity IDs -> matched if nonempty, otherwise unmapped
    |           `-- Stale evidence is never silently rebased
    `-- partitionFromSourceJoins -> concept partition
        |-- Accept matched joins for the requested diagram revision only
        |-- Leaf-to-group mapping assigns entities within the supplied universe
        `-- Retain overlapping memberships; smallest group ID is primary, or null
